About Me

I am a Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering graduate from Visayas State University – Isabel Campus.

My experience includes a hands-on Mechanical Engineering internship in a Motorpool Department, an engineering capstone involving design, fabrication, testing, and documentation, a HIRAC study, and two years of organizational experience as an Auditor in the Faculty of Engineering and Technology Student Council.

I am particularly interested in roles that combine engineering knowledge with structured documentation, data handling, project support, and safety practices.
